title: fleet-guards waste alarm fails open silently when fleet_burn.py errors
description: 3x codereview of lh2z fix (correctness finding 1, edge finding 2): scripts/fleet-guards.sh:86 swallows all helper failures (2>/dev/null), empty WASTE -> W_EVAL=False -> waste alarm silently never evaluates, no log line. Misses the helper-missing case (partial deploy of fleet-guards.sh without fleet_burn.py at the hardcoded $REPO path) and interpreter crashes. Fix: on empty WASTE or parse fallback, echo a warning line naming the failure, so the alarm fails loud rather than recreating the lh2z silent-death mode.
